ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 80:20 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels. The white intensity dominates the distal regions, while black intensity is concentrated in a central basal wedge.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous black wedge centered at the median notch, bifurcating slightly toward the center of each lobe. Discrete circular black spots are visible on the right lobe white field (mid-region) and a cluster of smaller dots on the inner-left lobe white field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel angle of 115 degrees; depth is roughly 10% of the total fluke vertical height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left lobe trailing edge is relatively smooth with low-amplitude micro-serrations. Right lobe trailing edge features a significant, high-amplitude concave indentation (notch) approximately two-thirds toward the tip. Both tips show irregular jagged topography caused by barnacle clusters.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory sweeping from the central notch to the distal tips, with a slight upward curve (concavity) near the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast circular clusters of light-toned pixels (white/beige) localized on the outer margins of both distal tips, indicating dense barnacle colonization. Small isolated dark circular spots on the ventral surface of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable semi-circular tissue loss/indentation on the trailing edge of the right lobe. Dense barnacle colonization on both distal fluke tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Asymmetric indentation on the right lobe trailing edge; speckled mottling at the transition zone between the central black pigment and the white fluke surface.
